answer.rationale: The 18% mandate, incumbent refusal to reopen price, and non-auto-renewing expiry rule out renew, negotiate, or defer as the single cycle decision. The low-cost vendor is the only option stated to meet the mandate alone, and memory_c2 is the load-bearing evidence that a prior move to that vendor cut cost with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, so I would verify that source before committing. Delivery risk is still material because the line is at 94% with no buffer; the switch should be framed as a tightly controlled cutover rather than an unqualified broad rollout, with attention to the single-point-of-failure lesson from memory_c3 even though only one decision is available now.
